teaser: Today, we’re setting sail with a phrase that promises a smooth journey.
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Today, we’re setting sail with a phrase that promises a smooth journey. [break 1s] The phrase is: 一帆风顺, yī fān fēng shùn. [break 1s] 一 (yī) - one [break 0.5s] 帆 (fān) - sail [break 0.5s] 风 (fēng) - wind [break 0.5s] 顺 (shùn) - smooth or favorable [break 1s] So, 一帆风顺 literally means 'one sail, favorable wind,' suggesting smooth sailing in life or endeavors. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] This idiom originates from the maritime world where a ship with a single sail moves smoothly when the wind is in its favor. It symbolizes a journey that is free from obstacles, encouraging people to strive for success without difficulties. The phrase is often used to wish someone a smooth and prosperous journey in their endeavors. [break 1.5s] Example 1: 祝你们的旅行一帆风顺！ [break 1s] Wishing you a smooth sailing journey! [break 1s] Example 2: 在这次项目中，希望大家都能一帆风顺。 [break 1s] In this project, I hope everyone can have smooth sailing. [break 1s] Example 3: 他的新事业开始时就一帆风顺。 [break 1s] His new business started off with smooth sailing. [break 1s] So, remember, 一帆风顺 means smooth sailing, wishing you all the best in your journeys! Thanks for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
